contentPattern.structure: per slide: full-bleed background image + title + optional subtext + CTA

suitableFor: homepage promotional carousels with full-bleed photographic slides
multi-message hero areas needing image + heading + subtext + single CTA per slide
notSuitableFor: single static hero banners (use hero-banner instead)
content carousels of small cards or thumbnails
text-only slide decks without background imagery
